build_sampler: build a SamplingMethod sampler from args and task using the build_sampler static method
run_uniform_sampling: run uniform sampling on a list of dataset sizes to get equal weights
run_temperature_sampling: run temperature-based sampling on dataset sizes with a configurable temperature parameter
create_temperature_factory: create a temperature sampling factory function with a fixed temperature value
create_ratio_factory: create a ratio sampling factory function that returns fixed ratios for any dataset sizes
